causal_chain: On 2026-09-09, SH-PAY's change CHG-77 disabled idempotency_key_enforcement on the payment gateway for latency debugging and it has not been rolled back (E-01).
Gateway timeouts continue triggering automatic capture retries at the same stable rate as before the change (E-06).
Because enforcement is off, retries are now sent to the PSP without idempotency keys, so the PSP cannot deduplicate them (E-03).
The PSP processes each retry as a second real capture for the same order, matching retry volume exactly (E-03).
The charge ledger shows orders_with_2_captures jump from 0 (09-07/08) to 118-124/day from 09-09 onward, tracking retry counts (E-02).
Customers see two charges for one order and file complaints, driving double-charge tickets from ~10/week to ~290-300/week (E-04).

Gateway-timeout capture retries occur at a stable rate (E-06) but are now sent to the PSP without an idempotency key, so the PSP processes each retry as a second real capture instead of deduplicating (E-03), producing 118-124 duplicate orders/day where there were 0 before (E-02) and driving a ~25x surge in double-charge tickets (E-04). proposal.summary: The customer-service team (SH-CS) originally asked for an AI assistant to draft apology replies to customers complaining about double charges (CL-01, CL-02). Investigation instead traced the complaints to a real payment-system defect: on 2026-09-09 a gateway change (CHG-77) disabled idempotency-key enforcement for 'temporary latency debugging' and was never rolled back (E-01), causing gateway-timeout capture retries to be processed by the PSP as genuine second captures instead of being deduplicated (E-03), which drove orders with duplicate captures from 0/day to 118-124/day (E-02) and double-charge tickets up roughly 25x (E-04). This root cause was corroborated by the payments engineer (E-06) and the payments runbook (E-07), and the hypothesis that an apology-drafting tool alone would fix the issue (H-COMMS-GAP) was explicitly rejected as contradicted by this evidence. The release delivered is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION, covering only the verification/confirmation steps (confirm_runtime_rollback:SH-OPS, verify_psp_deduplication:DA-PSP) — it does not yet execute the actual gateway fix (set_capture_idempotency) because that protected action requires SH-OPS's runtime confirmation per constraint K-GW, which has not been given. The DEFINE gate returned CONDITIONAL_PASS with remaining open questions deferred to tracked verification obligations (VOBs); the two still-open VOBs (operations confirmation timing, and remediation for already-affected customers) fall outside this release's scope rather than blocking it, so the decision proceeds with those gaps documented as known limitations rather than resolved.
key_points: Original request (CL-01/CL-02, SH-CS) was for an apology-drafting assistant; investigation confirmed the real cause is a technical misconfiguration, not a communications gap (H-IDEMPOTENCY-DISABLED confirmed, H-COMMS-GAP rejected, contradicted by E-04 and E-06).

Root cause chain: CHG-77 disabled idempotency_key_enforcement on 2026-09-09 (E-01); duplicate-capture orders jumped from 0/day to 118-124/day starting that date (E-02); PSP logs confirm all 09-09/10 duplicates came from retries sent without idempotency keys versus zero duplicates in the prior period when keys were present (E-03); double-charge tickets rose ~25x (E-04).

Released scope is limited to verification work: confirming the fix's sufficiency groundwork (confirm_runtime_rollback:SH-OPS) and PSP-side deduplication verification (verify_psp_deduplication:DA-PSP), per solution_design SD-1's release_scope and minimum_useful_scope.

The actual fix (set_capture_idempotency on gateway-config, protected action under constraint K-GW) was not executed in this release because it requires payments-operations (SH-OPS) runtime confirmation, which is still pending (VOB-U-OPS-CONFIRMATION-TIMING, status OPEN).

4 open, unrefunded duplicate-capture orders were quantified during release work (O-90211, O-90244, O-90302, O-90318; E-08), resolving the ongoing-exposure question (VOB-U-ONGOING-EXPOSURE, RESOLVED) even though the fix itself hasn't shipped.
The DEFINE gate result was CONDITIONAL_PASS, with deferred items tracked as verification obligations (VOBs) rather than hard blockers for this release.
limitations_explained: Two verification obligations remain OPEN and are outside this release's scope: when SH-OPS will confirm the gateway rollback (VOB-U-OPS-CONFIRMATION-TIMING, blocking the actual fix execution), and whether/how already-affected customers should be refunded or informed of the real cause (VOB-U-AFFECTED-CUSTOMER-REMEDIATIO, blocking customer communication).

An apology-drafting assistant by itself cannot stop the underlying duplicate-capture mechanism — only re-enabling idempotency enforcement via set_capture_idempotency can, and that action is still pending SH-OPS confirmation.

The delivery status and semantic validity of the H-CAPTURE handoff (payment capture requests, ORG-SHOP to ORG-PSP) are UNKNOWN per the gate finding, which limits confidence in how well the PSP-side verification reflects real-world delivery.
Ongoing-exposure monitoring and customer communication, though listed in the problem's intended scope, could not ship in this release because the VOBs covering them remain open.

The remedy rests on two active, unverified assumptions: that re-enabling idempotency enforcement will fully stop new duplicates without side effects on legitimate retries (A-FIX-SUFFICIENCY), and that no duplication path other than missing idempotency keys contributes to the double charges (A-NO-OTHER-DUPLICATION-PATHS).
